title: operator-algebras-positive widget params
description: The commutative picture of positivity in a C*-algebra. Working in the self-adjoint part of C({1,2}) ≅ ℝ² (an element is its pair of eigenvalues / its two function values), the positive cone A₊ is the first quadrant, the Löwner order a≤b is the translated cone, the order interval [0,1] is the unit square, and the positive square root b=√a (functional calculus) is a second point. Two sliders move the element a=(λ₁,λ₂); preset buttons jump to canonical elements. The verdict panel checks the three equivalent characterizations a≥0 ⇔ self-adjoint ∧ σ(a)⊆[0,∞) ⇔ a=b*b.

widgetId.description: DOM id for the outer <div class="widget"> wrapper.

title.description: Display title rendered inside .hd > .ttl. Keep it prose: .ttl is text-transform:uppercase, so a formula would be mangled.

lo.description: Lower bound of both eigenvalue axes (λ₁ and λ₂) on the plane plot and the sliders.

hi.description: Upper bound of both eigenvalue axes on the plane plot and the sliders.

step.description: Slider step for λ₁ and λ₂.

presets.description: Canonical example elements offered as jump-to buttons. Each is a self-adjoint element of C({1,2}) given by its two eigenvalues.

label.description: Button label (KaTeX-processed, e.g. a projection $p$ or the unit $1$).

l1.description: First eigenvalue λ₁ = value at point 1.

l2.description: Second eigenvalue λ₂ = value at point 2.
